messages:
sam.onboard: Heads-up from a new user—they hit `TypeError: createClient is not a function` when following the Node quickstart. Error comes from the README snippet.

nina.docs: Ugh. Which snippet? We recently changed the JS SDK export style (named export) but didn't update the README examples that show default import.

sam.onboard: Here's what they pasted from the README:```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

sam.onboard: Node 16 + CommonJS produces that runtime error because the package now exports named functions.

leo.sdk: Thanks for flagging. The canonical CommonJS example should be:```js
const { createClient } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

leo.sdk: And the ESM example should be:```js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

nina.docs: I'll update the README and the quickstart template. Also noticed the sample-app scaffold in github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app had a committed placeholder token string `REPLACE_WITH_API_TOKEN` in seeds/dev.env which some folks were copy/pasting into prod by accident. We should add a warning and a .env.example instead.

sam.onboard: Oof, saw someone actually commit a real token once in a forked demo earlier this month. We should add a short "do not commit" blurb and a git-secrets rule.

leo.sdk: I'll add a small compatibility note to the SDK Changelog as well so integrators know about export style change. For docs: include both CommonJS and ESM examples and call out Node versions.

nina.docs: Created PR #4710 to: - fix README import style - add ESM/CommonJS examples - replace seeds/dev.env with .env.example and a blurb about never committing credentials - link to git-secrets setup in the CONTRIBUTING guide. Preview link: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-4710

ci-bot: docs-preview: build 8012 passed, accessibility check ok, no broken links.

sam.onboard: Can we also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ line: "If you see createClient is not a function, try the named import variant or upgrade Node/ES module interop."

leo.sdk: Will open a small follow-up PR to add that line to the FAQ and bump the SDK minor if needed.

nina.docs: Merged PR after minor wording tweak. Backport issue created for v1.x docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/488.

sam.onboard: Thanks everyone, saved a new user a lot of time :relieved:
